entries.title: Psalms 119:1
segments: ¶ALEPH. Blessed [are] the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD. {undefiled: or, perfect, or, sincere}

entries.title: Psalms 119:2
segments: Blessed [are] they that keep his testimonies, [and that] seek him with the whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:3
segments: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:4
segments: ¶Thou hast commanded [us] to keep thy precepts diligently.

entries.title: Psalms 119:5
segments: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

entries.title: Psalms 119:6
segments: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

words.text: Then shall I not be ashamed

entries.title: Psalms 119:7
segments: ¶I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments. {thy...: Heb. judgments of thy righteousness}

entries.title: Psalms 119:8
segments: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:9
segments: ¶BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed [thereto] according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:10
segments: ¶With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

words.text: thee: O let me not wander

entries.title: Psalms 119:11
segments: ¶Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 119:12
segments: ¶Blessed [art] thou, O LORD: teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:13
segments: ¶With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:14
segments: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as [much as] in all riches.

entries.title: Psalms 119:15
segments: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

entries.title: Psalms 119:16
segments: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:17
segments: ¶GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, [that] I may live, and keep thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:18
segments: ¶Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law. {Open: Heb. Reveal}

entries.title: Psalms 119:19
segments: ¶I [am] a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:20
segments: ¶My soul breaketh for the longing [that it hath] unto thy judgments at all times.

entries.title: Psalms 119:21
segments: ¶Thou hast rebuked the proud [that are] cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:22
segments: ¶Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:23
segments: ¶Princes also did sit [and] speak against me: [but] thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:24
segments: ¶Thy testimonies also [are] my delight [and] my counsellors. {my counsellors: Heb. men of my counsel}

words.text: . {my counsellors: Heb. men of my counsel}

entries.title: Psalms 119:25
segments: ¶DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

words.text: thou me according to thy word

entries.title: Psalms 119:26
segments: ¶I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:27
segments: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 119:28
segments: ¶My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word. {melteth: Heb. droppeth}

words.text: thou me according unto thy word

entries.title: Psalms 119:29
segments: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

entries.title: Psalms 119:30
segments: ¶I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid [before me].

entries.title: Psalms 119:31
segments: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O LORD, put me not to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 119:32
segments: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:33
segments: ¶HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it [unto] the end.

entries.title: Psalms 119:34
segments: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with [my] whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:35
segments: ¶Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:36
segments: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:37
segments: ¶Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; [and] quicken thou me in thy way. {Turn...: Heb. Make to pass}

entries.title: Psalms 119:38
segments: ¶Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who [is devoted] to thy fear.

entries.title: Psalms 119:39
segments: ¶Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments [are] good.

entries.title: Psalms 119:40
segments: ¶Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:41
segments: ¶VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O LORD, [even] thy salvation, according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:42
segments: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word. {So...: or, So shall I answer him that reproveth me in a thing}

words.text: . {So...: or, So shall I answer him that reproveth me in a thing}

entries.title: Psalms 119:43
segments: ¶And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:44
segments: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:45
segments: ¶And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts. {at liberty: Heb. at large}

entries.title: Psalms 119:46
segments: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:47
segments: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

entries.title: Psalms 119:48
segments: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:49
segments: ¶ZAIN. Remember the word unto thy servant, upon which thou hast caused me to hope.

words.text: , upon which thou hast caused me to hope

entries.title: Psalms 119:50
segments: ¶This [is] my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:51
segments: ¶The proud have had me greatly in derision: [yet] have I not declined from thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:52
segments: ¶I remembered thy judgments of old, O LORD; and have comforted myself.

entries.title: Psalms 119:53
segments: ¶Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

words.text: upon me because of the wicked

entries.title: Psalms 119:54
segments: ¶Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

entries.title: Psalms 119:55
segments: ¶I have remembered thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have kept thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:56
segments: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

words.text: This I had, because I kept

entries.title: Psalms 119:57
segments: ¶CHETH. [Thou art] my portion, O LORD: I have said that I would keep thy words.

entries.title: Psalms 119:58
segments: ¶I intreated thy favour with [my] whole heart: be merciful unto me according to thy word. {favour: Heb. face}

words.text: unto me according to thy word

entries.title: Psalms 119:59
segments: ¶I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:60
segments: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:61
segments: ¶The bands of the wicked have robbed me: [but] I have not forgotten thy law. {bands: or, companies}

entries.title: Psalms 119:62
segments: ¶At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

words.text: unto thee because of thy righteous

entries.title: Psalms 119:63
segments: ¶I [am] a companion of all [them] that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

words.text: thee, and of them that keep

entries.title: Psalms 119:64
segments: ¶The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:65
segments: ¶TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O LORD, according unto thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:66
segments: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:67
segments: ¶Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:68
segments: ¶Thou [art] good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:69
segments: ¶The proud have forged a lie against me: [but] I will keep thy precepts with [my] whole heart.

entries.title: Psalms 119:70
segments: Their heart is as fat as grease; [but] I delight in thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:71
segments: ¶[It is] good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

words.text: for me that I have been afflicted

entries.title: Psalms 119:72
segments: ¶The law of thy mouth [is] better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

entries.title: Psalms 119:73
segments: ¶JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:74
segments: ¶They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:75
segments: ¶I know, O LORD, that thy judgments [are] right, and [that] thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me. {right: Heb. righteousness}

entries.title: Psalms 119:76
segments: ¶Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to thy word unto thy servant. {for...: Heb. to comfort me}

words.text: ¶Let, I pray thee, thy merciful kindness

entries.title: Psalms 119:77
segments: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law [is] my delight.

words.text: unto me, that I may live

entries.title: Psalms 119:78
segments: ¶Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: [but] I will meditate in thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:79
segments: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

words.text: unto me, and those that have known

entries.title: Psalms 119:80
segments: ¶Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

entries.title: Psalms 119:81
segments: ¶CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: [but] I hope in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:82
segments: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:83
segments: ¶For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; [yet] do I not forget thy statutes.

words.text: ¶For I am become like a bottle

entries.title: Psalms 119:84
segments: ¶How many [are] the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

entries.title: Psalms 119:85
segments: ¶The proud have digged pits for me, which [are] not after thy law.

words.text: for me, which [are] not after thy law

entries.title: Psalms 119:86
segments: All thy commandments [are] faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me. {faithful: Heb. faithfulness}

entries.title: Psalms 119:87
segments: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:88
segments: ¶Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:89
segments: ¶LAMED. For ever, O LORD, thy word is settled in heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 119:90
segments: Thy faithfulness [is] unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth. {unto...: Heb. to generation and generation} {abideth: Heb. standeth}

words.text: . {unto...: Heb. to generation and generation} {abideth: Heb. standeth}

entries.title: Psalms 119:91
segments: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all [are] thy servants.

entries.title: Psalms 119:92
segments: ¶Unless thy law [had been] my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

entries.title: Psalms 119:93
segments: ¶I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

words.text: : for with them thou hast quickened

entries.title: Psalms 119:94
segments: ¶I [am] thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:95
segments: ¶The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: [but] I will consider thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:96
segments: ¶I have seen an end of all perfection: [but] thy commandment [is] exceeding broad.

entries.title: Psalms 119:97
segments: ¶MEM. O how love I thy law! it [is] my meditation all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 119:98
segments: ¶Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they [are] ever with me. {they...: Heb. it is ever with me}

words.text: with me. {they...: Heb. it is ever with me}

entries.title: Psalms 119:99
segments: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies [are] my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 119:100
segments: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:101
segments: ¶I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:102
segments: ¶I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:103
segments: ¶How sweet are thy words unto my taste! [yea, sweeter] than honey to my mouth! {taste: Heb. palate}

entries.title: Psalms 119:104
segments: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:105
segments: ¶NUN. Thy word [is] a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path. {lamp: or, candle}

entries.title: Psalms 119:106
segments: ¶I have sworn, and I will perform [it], that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:107
segments: ¶I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:108
segments: ¶Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me thy judgments.

words.text: , I beseech thee, the freewill offerings

entries.title: Psalms 119:109
segments: ¶My soul [is] continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:110
segments: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:111
segments: ¶Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they [are] the rejoicing of my heart.

words.text: have I taken as an heritage

entries.title: Psalms 119:112
segments: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, [even unto] the end. {to perform: Heb. to do}

entries.title: Psalms 119:113
segments: ¶SAMECH. I hate [vain] thoughts: but thy law do I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:114
segments: ¶Thou [art] my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:115
segments: ¶Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

entries.title: Psalms 119:116
segments: ¶Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

words.text: : and let me not be ashamed

entries.title: Psalms 119:117
segments: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

entries.title: Psalms 119:118
segments: ¶Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit [is] falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 119:119
segments: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth [like] dross: therefore I love thy testimonies. {puttest...: Heb. causest to cease}

entries.title: Psalms 119:120
segments: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

words.text: of thee; and I am afraid

entries.title: Psalms 119:121
segments: ¶AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

entries.title: Psalms 119:122
segments: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:123
segments: ¶Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:124
segments: ¶Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:125
segments: I [am] thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:126
segments: ¶[It is] time for [thee], LORD, to work: [for] they have made void thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:127
segments: ¶Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

entries.title: Psalms 119:128
segments: Therefore I esteem all [thy] precepts [concerning] all [things to be] right; [and] I hate every false way.

entries.title: Psalms 119:129
segments: ¶PE. Thy testimonies [are] wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

entries.title: Psalms 119:130
segments: ¶The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

entries.title: Psalms 119:131
segments: ¶I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:132
segments: ¶Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name. {as thou...: Heb. according to the custom toward those, etc}

words.text: thou upon me, and be merciful
to do unto those that love
. {as thou...: Heb. according to the custom toward those, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 119:133
segments: ¶Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:134
segments: ¶Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:135
segments: ¶Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:136
segments: ¶Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:137
segments: ¶TZADDI. Righteous [art] thou, O LORD, and upright [are] thy judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:138
segments: Thy testimonies [that] thou hast commanded [are] righteous and very faithful. {righteous: Heb. righteousness} {faithful: Heb. faithfulness}

entries.title: Psalms 119:139
segments: ¶My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words. {consumed...: Heb. cut me off}

entries.title: Psalms 119:140
segments: ¶Thy word [is] very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it. {pure: Heb. tried, or, refined}

entries.title: Psalms 119:141
segments: ¶I [am] small and despised: [yet] do not I forget thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:142
segments: ¶Thy righteousness [is] an everlasting righteousness, and thy law [is] the truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:143
segments: ¶Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: [yet] thy commandments [are] my delights. {taken...: Heb. found me}

entries.title: Psalms 119:144
segments: The righteousness of thy testimonies [is] everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

entries.title: Psalms 119:145
segments: ¶KOPH. I cried with [my] whole heart; hear me, O LORD: I will keep thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:146
segments: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies. {and I...: or, that I may keep}

words.text: . {and I...: or, that I may keep}

entries.title: Psalms 119:147
segments: ¶I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:148
segments: Mine eyes prevent the [night] watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:149
segments: ¶Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O LORD, quicken me according to thy judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 119:150
segments: ¶They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

entries.title: Psalms 119:151
segments: Thou [art] near, O LORD; and all thy commandments [are] truth.

entries.title: Psalms 119:152
segments: ¶Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 119:153
segments: ¶RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

words.text: me: for I do not forget

entries.title: Psalms 119:154
segments: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:155
segments: ¶Salvation [is] far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:156
segments: ¶Great [are] thy tender mercies, O LORD: quicken me according to thy judgments. {Great: or, Many}

entries.title: Psalms 119:157
segments: ¶Many [are] my persecutors and mine enemies; [yet] do I not decline from thy testimonies.

entries.title: Psalms 119:158
segments: ¶I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:159
segments: ¶Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:160
segments: ¶Thy word [is] true [from] the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments [endureth] for ever. {Thy word...: Heb. The beginning of thy word is true}

words.text: : and every one of thy righteous
. {Thy word...: Heb. The beginning of thy word is true}

entries.title: Psalms 119:161
segments: ¶SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:162
segments: ¶I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

entries.title: Psalms 119:163
segments: ¶I hate and abhor lying: [but] thy law do I love.

entries.title: Psalms 119:164
segments: ¶Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:165
segments: ¶Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them. {nothing...: Heb. they shall have no stumblingblock}

words.text: them. {nothing...: Heb. they shall have no stumblingblock}

entries.title: Psalms 119:166
segments: ¶LORD, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

entries.title: Psalms 119:167
segments: ¶My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

entries.title: Psalms 119:168
segments: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways [are] before thee.

entries.title: Psalms 119:169
segments: ¶TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O LORD: give me understanding according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:170
segments: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

entries.title: Psalms 119:171
segments: ¶My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

entries.title: Psalms 119:172
segments: ¶My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments [are] righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 119:173
segments: ¶Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

entries.title: Psalms 119:174
segments: I have longed for thy salvation, O LORD; and thy law [is] my delight.

entries.title: Psalms 119:175
segments: ¶Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

entries.title: Psalms 119:176
segments: ¶I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.
